concerns.text: SC-002 is a verbatim duplicate of SC-001 ('The difference in buffer cycles required to reach [deferred] accuracy...'). It lacks a distinct metric definition or reference to a different user story, creating an orphaned success criterion that does not map to a unique goal.

FR-007 anchors to 'Edge Cases' rather than a specific User Story (e.g., US-1 or US-2). While the Edge Cases section is part of the spec, the lens requires explicit anchoring to a User Story or Goal to prevent scope creep. The requirement should be re-anchored to US-1 (Baseline) or US-2 (CAP) where the prompt generation logic resides.
